Filter by several accounts at once.

- **Accounts filter picks more than one account**, on Home and in Activity → Filters. Tap accounts in the list to tick or untick them; the menu stays open so you can pick several. "All accounts" clears the choice. The chip shows the account's name, or "2 accounts", "3 accounts" and so on.
- A linked debit card is still included with its account.

APK: arm64-v8a, built and signed by GitHub Actions.
